narration.text: This free AI editor makes paid tools look like a bad joke.
At number five, CapCut. It offers an impressive suite of professional editing features, making complex tasks simple. You get incredible effects and templates without spending a penny.

Number four is DaVinci Resolve. It is professional grade software for editing, colour correction, and audio. It is astonishing that such a powerful tool has a free version, matching many paid alternatives.
Coming in at number three, RunwayML. This tool provides advanced AI features like background removal and object deletion with ease. It is like having a Hollywood studio in your browser, for free.
At number two, Descript. This revolutionary editor lets you edit video by editing text, and even removes filler words automatically. It makes editing faster and more intuitive than ever before.
Our number one spot goes to Klavaro. This incredible tool offers instant video generation from text, meaning no editing is required at all. It is truly mind blowing and completely free to use.
Klavaro is a game changer for content creation. Did we miss your go-to free AI editor?
